messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] NebulaEdge - EU prod - ACME INDUSTRIES (account: ACME-771) reporting increased 5xx on dedicated instance. Affects routing API + embeddings. Paging @sre-oncall @oncall-cs for mitigation and customer comms. incident id INC-20260317-NEB

maria.g: I'm on it. Can someone confirm scope (routing API, embeddings, dashboard?)

raj.p: seeing a spike of 502/504s from nebulaedge-eu-front. Spike started ~2026-03-17T12:34Z. Error rate p95 ~18%. Looks like upstream gateway timeouts to the KV cache primaries.

kevin.h (acct-team): ACME contact list: Alice (alice@acme.com), Bob Ops (bob@acme.com), CSM Claire (claire@acme.com). They expect a tailored notice — please include impact %, what we're doing, and expected next update window.

alyssa: drafting short external blurb now. Proposed: "We're investigating 5xx errors affecting your NebulaEdge dedicated instance. We've routed traffic to a backup pool to mitigate. You may see increased latency and intermittent failures for routing and embeddings. We'll update within 30 minutes or upon resolution." Add status page link?

sre-oncall: Raj, please start fallback to backup pool. Command to use: ```rollout-service --service nebulaedge-front --target pool:backup-eu --max-in-flight 2``` Watch cache warm-up and embeddings hit-rate. I'll watch metrics and traces.

raj.p: executing fallback now... => started rollout job 8721. Rolling out 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 6m windows.

incident-bot: Internal status draft posted (private): https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-20260317-NEB (staging)

maria.g: Alyssa, add tailored impact line for ACME: "ACME Industries (NebulaEdge dedicated) — impact to real-time routing and embedding lookups used by search/assist. Estimated up to ~20% of requests affected at peak; customers may see 500s and 2–6s additional latency during mitigation."

alyssa: added that wording and included specific contact routing: Primary: Alice (eng), Secondary: Bob (ops). Will send secure notification to Alice & Bob and CC Claire.

kevin.h: Also include mitigation plan note: "If fallback doesn't bring error rate below 5% in 20m we'll scale dedicated pool by +2 GPUs and open support window with priority infra."

raj.p: fallback reduced 5xx from ~18% -> ~4% within ~4 minutes after 50% shift. Backup pool CPU trending up but within headroom. Embedding cache cold misses spiked briefly.

maria.g: good, keep monitoring. Alyssa please push the customer notice and update the status page to "mitigating". I'll prepare P0 postmortem stub and note ACME as high-touch.

alyssa: Sent secure note to ACME ops (via secure channel): "We're routing traffic to a backup pool to mitigate elevated 5xxs on your NebulaEdge instance. You may see transient 500s and higher latencies while caches warm. We'll update again in 30 minutes or when we move to full resolution. — Maria (Redwood SRE)"

kevin.h: Claire (CSM) looped in, she'll coordinate any customer questions.

oncall-cs: taking handoff for customer comms and post-resolve follow-up. Will schedule a 1:1 with ACME for a post-incident review tomorrow.

maria.g: handing monitoring and follow-up to night shift SREs. Raj, please keep the rollback plan ready and capture rollout job logs. Thanks team :thumbsup:

raj.p: capturing logs and will attach to incident page. If error rate rises above 8% we roll back the rollout and scale up GPUs per Kevin's plan.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260317-NEB status: MITIGATING. Next update scheduled +30m.

maria.g: noted. I'll author tailored customer impact blurb for the postmortem and include timeline + decisions.

alyssa: final external snippet I'm pushing to status and ACME: "Mitigation in place: traffic routed to backup pool; errors reduced significantly. We continue to monitor and will follow up with a post-incident summary for ACME."

kevin.h: thanks everyone. Closing handoff to oncall-cs for customer-facing follow up.

oncall-cs: acknowledged — will send a confirmation email once metrics stable and draft the ACME postmortem invite.
